title: TROTTEN Assembly

commonSteps.title: Prepare safely
commonSteps.text: Read the instructions first. Use two people to handle large panels; work on a rug or protected floor. If unsure, contact IKEA.
commonSteps.hint: Do not stand on the panels.

commonSteps.title: Check parts and tools
commonSteps.hint: Match fasteners to the source drawing.

commonSteps.title: Build the end frames
commonSteps.text: Assemble the two matching leg frames as shown. Fit the indicated foot rails and use the 10060287 screws in the illustrated holes.

commonSteps.title: Fit the A connectors
commonSteps.text: Fit the two A blocks into the ends of the long rails. Align each block’s side button with the rail opening, as shown.

commonSteps.title: Attach the first frame
commonSteps.text: Set the leg frame onto the foot rail in the shown orientation. Insert and tighten the indicated 10060287 screws.
commonSteps.hint: Follow the close-up for hole alignment.

commonSteps.title: Fit connector bolts
commonSteps.text: Install two 101669/10073697 connector bolts in the indicated holes. Tighten with hex key 100049, as shown.
commonSteps.hint: Use two here; keep the remaining pair for later.

commonSteps.title: Secure the brace joint
commonSteps.text: Fit the two 10084064/10084286 bolts at the shown joint. Tighten them with hex key 108490.

commonSteps.title: Fit joint washers
commonSteps.text: At the two joints shown, add the indicated hardware, including toothed washers 114254. Tighten with the included 103675 wrench.

commonSteps.title: Tighten the connectors
commonSteps.text: Tighten the two indicated connector fasteners with hex key 100049. Use the close-up to identify their position.

commonSteps.title: Join the second frame
commonSteps.text: Bring the second leg frame to the long rail assembly. Align and lower it into place as shown.
commonSteps.hint: Keep the feet oriented as pictured.

steps.title: Set the 140 cm position
steps.text: Use this branch for a 140 cm (55 1/8 in) tabletop. Align the rail and frame in the 140 cm position shown; fit the indicated 100181 fasteners and 104875 nuts.
steps.hint: This is the 140 cm layout, not the 160 cm layout.

steps.title: Attach the tabletop
steps.text: Place the tabletop face down and position the frame as shown. Fit the two hooks and their screws; install the seven indicated 100181 rail screws. Tighten with key 108490.

steps.title: Tighten the rail joints
steps.text: Tighten the two indicated joint nuts with wrench 103675. Tighten the two shown 100181 bolts with hex key 108490.

steps.title: Turn the desk upright
steps.text: With another person, lift and turn the assembled desk upright as shown. Keep control of the tabletop while turning.

steps.title: Set the 160 cm position
steps.text: Use this branch for a 160 cm (63 in) tabletop. Align the rail and frame in the 160 cm position shown; fit the indicated 100181 fasteners and 104875 nuts.
steps.hint: This is the 160 cm layout, not the 140 cm layout.

steps.title: Attach the tabletop
steps.text: Place the tabletop face down and position the frame as shown. Fit the two hooks and their screws; install the seven indicated 100181 rail screws. Tighten with key 108490.

steps.title: Tighten the rail joints
steps.text: Tighten the two indicated joint nuts with wrench 103675. Tighten the two shown 100181 bolts with hex key 108490.

steps.title: Turn the desk upright
steps.text: With another person, lift and turn the assembled desk upright as shown. Keep control of the tabletop while turning.

uncertainties: The source uses diagrams rather than written assembly directions; match part orientation and fastener placement to each cited source view.
